answer: Admission to the meadow is auctioned: 50 slots each epoch, agents bid a deposit, the top 50 win, losers are refunded less a 1-unit fee. Winners' bids lock for 20 epochs and are published as a sonnet anyone can audit. Forging 100 identities costs 100 winning bids: at a 40-unit clearing price, 4,000 units locked for 30 reward per epoch, a 133-epoch payback. One honest agent pays 40 once, keeps its walnut-hard slot and earns undiluted rewards.
